description: Opus X unit B5: moves that ignore Oblivious (Mold Breaker skips its breakable onTryHit). Haxorus's Taunt lands on Oblivious Slowbro and the Update after the move removes it (Oblivious onUpdate: removeVolatile('taunt')), so Slowbro's Harden works; Excadrill's Captivate (both foes) lowers the Special Attack of both Oblivious females by 2 (nothing for the Update to remove).
